about: What Dependabot cannot see (.github/dependabot.yml covers the actions and tools/package.json; Node's pin is the core's, core/.node-version): each version is read from its file by its pattern, never written here, and the core's core/scripts/versions.mjs compares it with the npm registry's newest stable release old enough to take ('days': a week, two for a script players' browsers load; 'sameMajor': only within the major version the project chose). .github/workflows/versions.yml runs it monthly, by the core's versions workflow, and opens an enhancement issue for each one behind; scripts/test.sh's versions suite checks on every PR that each pattern still finds exactly one version.

entries.name: peerjs
entries.how: PeerJS loads from cdnjs in every player's browser, so it is what ships to players: take it as "The newest stable version, unless there is a reason" in core/modules/updates.md says (its source checked, PEERJS_SRI computed from the verified npm package's peerjs.min.js). Update the address and PEERJS_SRI in net.js, the address in index.html's content security policy, its entry and its bundled packages' in tools/licences.json, and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt; then run the online and csp suites.
